snippet.description:
After I Became King of the Unstable SMP, the world split into two different sides: the new players, and the old ones. Soon enough, most of these players left my Kingdom and joined Cindercrest. And just like that... a Civil War had begun. 

Unstable SMP:
➜ ‪  ‪  ‪‪@FlameFragsMC 
➜     @wemmbumc 
➜     ‪‪@Spokeishere 
➜     @ParrotX2  

Like ParrotX2 and his Unstable SMP series, where he is escaping Paragon / Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison, or got hunted by a Minecraft Player who doesn't exist. This is a new and original Minecraft idea like HermitCraft or Lifesteal with Wemmbu, FlameFrags, or Spoke. Survival is harder than Hardcore Minecraft because PVP is on.

Air Defense System and Arrow Orbital Cannon created by @cubicmetre 

People in this video: @TheobaldTheBird @FlameFragsMC@saparata  @Lomedy @fymada @4CVIT @yungymc

In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community. ROBLOX is designed for 13 to 18 year olds, but it is open to people of all ages. Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

Inspired by the emotional depth of Lumi Elara, “FOREVER” is a powerful uplifting trance journey about love that transcends time, distance, and loss.

Built around soaring female vocals, euphoric melodies, cinematic atmospheres, and emotional drops, the track captures the feeling of holding onto someone long after the moment is gone — when memories become part of you forever.

“FOREVER” moves between vulnerability and strength, blending delicate emotional breakdowns with explosive trance energy that lifts everything into the sky.
It’s the sound of late-night thoughts, endless horizons, and emotions too deep to fade away.
For the hearts that still remember.
For the souls that never truly let go.
For the moments that stay with you forever.

Close your eyes.
Feel the rush.
And disappear into FOREVER.

snippet.title: Global Chat, Ore from Hero Upgrades, Multiplayer Improvements & More!
snippet.description:
Update Information for Clash of Clans was received from General Manager, Sabrina, within the Inside the Builders Hut Episode. This included Improvements to the Ore Economy including receiving it for Hero Upgrades, as well as improvements to Ranked and Battle Mode. Information on Events in the future was also discussed along with the most surprising, Global Chat! When discussing the future social aspects of Clash of Clans Global Chat was strongly hinted towards making a return. Judo Sloth shares all of this information as well as sharing his own take on what we found out from the Inside the Builder Hut Episode. Clash On!

Inside the Builder Hut Ep.4 - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=12LciunDNC4

My New Series! Beating Every League - Ep.1 Skeleton: https://youtu.be/AWMA3IMkHV0?si=M-nxP1FrBsPcCqkx
